edges.reason: setStartingIndex reads startingIndexBlock to compute startingIndex.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock writes startingIndexBlock = block.number.
setStartingIndex assigns the derived value to startingIndex.
startingIndex is computed as blockhash % MAX_SBS, dependent on MAX_SBS.
mintSB requires saleIsActive before minting.
msg.sender is used as the mint recipient in mintSB.
mintSB compares block.timestamp against REVEAL_TIMESTAMP, a miner-influenceable dependency.
REVEAL_TIMESTAMP determines when startingIndexBlock may be set in mintSB.
mintSB enforces totalSupply().add(numberOfTokens) <= MAX_SBS using SafeMath.
mintSB computes SBPrice.mul(numberOfTokens) for the payment check.
mintSB pushes minted indexes into the tokenIndexes storage array.
mintSB calls _safeMint, which triggers an external receiver callback.
_safeMint invokes _checkOnERC721Received after minting.
_checkOnERC721Received performs a low-level functionCall to the recipient contract.
The callback is invoked with _msgSender() as operator on an attacker-controlled recipient contract.
withdraw forwards the whole contract balance through msg.sender.transfer.
withdraw sends Ether to msg.sender, executing recipient code (fallback/receive).
onlyOwner modifier restricts withdraw to the owner.
onlyOwner modifier restricts reserveSBs to the owner.
onlyOwner modifier restricts setRevealTimestamp.
onlyOwner modifier restricts setBaseURI.
onlyOwner modifier restricts setTokenURI.
onlyOwner modifier restricts flipSaleState.
onlyOwner modifier restricts emergencySetStartingIndexBlock.
reserveSBs loops 35 times calling _safeMint, each firing an external receiver callback.
reserveSBs requires !tokensReserved before reserving.
reserveSBs sets tokensReserved = true at the end.
reserveSBs mints all reserved tokens to msg.sender.
numberOfTokens drives the mint loop and the SafeMath price and supply multiplications.
revealTimeStamp parameter is assigned to REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
setRevealTimestamp mutates the REVEAL_TIMESTAMP state variable.
baseURI parameter flows into _setBaseURI.
tokenId parameter flows into _setTokenURI.
_tokenURI parameter flows into _setTokenURI.
name_ parameter initializes the ERC721 name in the constructor.
symbol_ parameter initializes the ERC721 symbol in the constructor.
constructor sets MAX_SBS from the maxNftSupply argument.
constructor sets REVEAL_TIMESTAMP from saleStart.
constructor initializes tokensReserved to false.
newOwner parameter flows into the ownership transfer.
transferOwnership rewrites the _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to address(0).
from parameter flows into _safeTransfer.
to parameter flows into _safeTransfer.
tokenId parameter flows into _safeTransfer.
_data parameter is forwarded to the receiver callback in _safeTransfer.
_safeTransfer invokes the external receiver callback on the destination contract.
safeTransferFrom delegates to _safeTransfer which performs the callback.
_isApprovedOrOwner consults approval state before transfers proceed.
local balance holds the full contract balance sent by the unsafe transfer.
local supply snapshots totalSupply for the reserve mint loop.
loop counter i bounds the 35-iteration reserve loop.
mintedIndexes memory array is initially assigned to tokenIndexes in mintSB.
mintIndex captures totalSupply() per mint iteration in mintSB.
returndata holds the raw external call result before decoding.
retval is the decoded selector compared against _ERC721_RECEIVED, trusting external return data.
